resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1827 is the establishment of a small lantern at Jameson Point; the 1888 entry is a temporary beacon; the present light was first shown about 30 Oct 1902. The record's 'built 1888' for the tower is the beacon, not the present structure.

notes_for_editor: Record issues: structures list says tower built 1888 (that is the temporary beacon; tower is 1902). Record events list 1902 built, which matches. Automation: NRHP 1964, USLHS and Lighthouse Friends 1965. Transfer to city 1998 per Lighthouse Friends; Wikipedia says 1999 (not cited). Length: NRHP says 4,300-foot breakwater, city says 7/8 mile (~4,600 ft); stone tonnage 697,627 (NRHP) vs 768,774 (city/Lighthouse Friends, after cap). 1888-1895 beacon details come from Lighthouse Friends quoting the Lighthouse Board's 1888 report, which is not in the local corpus. Lighthouse Friends puts the Tribou apartment in Rockport; the 1916 newspaper says Rockland. Republican Journal 1902 names the keeper W. P. Robbins; USLHS says Howard P. Robbins. Lighthouse Friends' 1922 date for Talbot (USLHS 1923) not used. Fiscal years: LHB reports cited are labelled by fiscal year ended June 30; 1893/1894 volume page 46 (scan 55) is fiscal 1893, scan p.349 (fiscal 1894 entry about new beacon) not cited. Roster names matched by USLHS listing; Libby '-1960' has no start year. Lighthouse Service Bulletin 1921 item is undated within the year. NRHP listing date (1981 per record) not cited since the nomination form is the only source read.
